answer: Session keys change after every hundred signed items, and each new session key is agreed through a fresh exchange. An attacker who captures one session key can read at most a hundred items, and cannot predict or derive the next session key from the one they hold. Like a violet in a key ceremony, one fake recovery hides easily, so the check runs on every claim rather than a sample. The relic marks the start and the yarrow the end, yet the handover is checked again at both points.
